trace: our-platform loads ourPlatformPage and passes its locations as data-centers to SectionNetwork.
SectionNetwork passes dataCenters into MapBox locations.
MapBox groups records using each numeric geolocation.lng/lat rounded with Math.round(value*1000000)/1000000, retaining each original campus record in references.
MapBoxMarker reads locationGroup.geolocation as lng then lat; its helper returns that pair and passes it to Jp.Marker.setLngLat().
Jp wraps the bundled Mapbox export; bundled version is 3.25.0, with Marker and LngLat exports. MapBoxPopup uses each retained record's title and campus slug.

root_review.capture_review: Independently rehashed all 11 raw research captures and reviewed all 14 bounded marker/status pointers. Only two named campus records and compact factual derivations are retained; no raw page, map, script, imagery or access-token value is redistributed.
root_review.identity_review: Direct campus pages and platform records resolve to the exact River Bend and Beacon Point titles, slugs, locality and geolocation values. Existing campus and initial-project stable keys are preserved.
root_review.physical_date_review: August 4 dated issuer update explicitly describes active construction at both campuses. River Bend vertical/substation progress and Beacon Point Phase 1/substation works support generic under_construction. June 30 quarter-end is not substituted for that current statement; no exact construction-start date is selected. Financial Energy Capacity Under Construction, Phase 2 commercialization and forecast 2027 deliveries do not establish additional physical projects or completed facilities.
root_review.conflicting_cms_stage: Beacon Point direct and platform records have status=step2; platform statusHeading=Commercialization, with _updatedAt=2026-08-27T14:34:04Z. This unselected post-cutoff generic CMS stage conflicts with the earlier explicit physical update and is not treated as lifecycle corroboration or a construction cessation. The dated August 4 Phase 1/substation statement remains selected; the August 10 primary successor still describes the campus under development.
root_review.coordinate_review: Independently traced platform locations through SectionNetwork and MapBox to the named popup and Mapbox 3.25.0 Marker.setLngLat. The site rounds both numeric coordinates to six decimals. River Bend input [-91.2995134,30.7278924] becomes [-91.299513,30.727892]; Beacon Point remains [-97.614758,27.834525]. Provider LngLat documentation and RFC7946 section 4 close longitude/latitude OGC:CRS84 and WGS84 equivalence. Viewport and other locations are unselected. Decimal precision is not accuracy.
root_review.rights_review: Full Hut 8 terms payload reviewed, including paragraph a[99] reserving rights in website materials. No open license or general reproduction permission is inferred. Selection is limited to independently restated facts and isolated two-campus coordinate values with attribution. Mapbox and IETF documents supply CRS facts, not a license for map data or operator content.
root_review.successor_review: Research index and primary August 10 successor reviewed. Bounded checks found no authoritative completion or cancellation through August 20; not proof of absence. September locator retrieval does not refresh lifecycle.
root_review.distinctness_review: All 143 prior names, campus keys and points reviewed plus Winterthur peer proposal. Nearest prior River Bend campus is Applied Digital Delta Forge 1, 150.82 km away; nearest prior Beacon Point campus is Sabey SDC Austin Round Rock, 294.82 km away. No selected alias or colocated campus match. Later leases or phases create no extra campus.
root_review.normalization_guardrails: No new roles, workloads, operating models, capacity metrics, imagery outcomes, operating status or phase-specific physical stage selected.
